source_stage_socket_policy.directory_suffix: first 24 hex characters of SHA256(os.fsencode(canonical PGDATA))
source_stage_socket_policy.precondition: exact socket directory absent before any PostgreSQL setup

postgres_bootstrap_policy.method: copy only the exact stopped, uninstalled PG18 initdb seed into new attempt13; public Truss 0.0.55 install/accept/register creates all source state from a fresh cluster
postgres_bootstrap_policy.source_claim: seed attempt4 is only a stopped initdb bootstrap cluster; it has no Truss installation, accepted model, source consumer, publication or ACK. Attempt13 is a fresh public .55 install; attempt12 was a cleanly reconciled install-timeout refusal with no source consumer, Spark, Delta or ACK.
postgres_bootstrap_policy.initdb_mode: --no-sync applies only to seed initdb bootstrap; PostgreSQL fsync must be observed on before source operations
postgres_bootstrap_policy.install_statement_timeout_scope: SET LOCAL statement_timeout and the adopted Truss host statement/operation caps are each 60000ms. Public install_in_transaction receives operation_timeout_ms=180000 only; its operation deadline is bounded separately, while other setup/query operations retain 15000ms and the outer supervisor remains 900 seconds.
